about: The cases Telegram's divisions are held to: plain words divided under a limit in UTF-16 units at the last pause that fits or between whole characters, a transcript folded under its voice as a caption and replies, and a bot's id read out of its token.

plainParts.name: words within one message stand whole
an empty text is one empty part
a blank line is the first pause
a line break is the next
a pause at the very start is no cut
emoji are two units each and never parted
a skin-tone cluster is one character
letters with no pause are cut at the limit
a cluster longer than the window is parted between code points
Hangul syllables are one unit each

transcriptParts.name: a short reading is one escaped caption
an empty reading has no parts
a reading past the caption goes on in a reply
